title: The gift of fear
coreMove: Keep fear useful by checking whether it is attached to present evidence, then let it guide boundaries and action.
sourcePressure: The close integrates signal, intuition, boundary clarity, preparation, and the distinction between evidence-bound fear and worry or panic.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating every anxious feeling as truth or turning fear into a philosophy.
sourceAnchorNote: Frozen notes contain source guidance but no traceable named anecdote, study, place, date, or artifact suitable for natural prose anchoring; use fictional protagonists only and keep claims tied to the listed source pressure.

hook: opening with a generic alarm-bell sentence for ch15
starting with a definition of fear, intuition, danger, or prediction
counterintuition: the safe move is not always the polite move

tryThisNow: set a timer and list your boundaries
examples: generic office hallway pressure with no access detail
